items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...the Charlie Shavers and Russell Crowe Colt. [INTERVIEWEE] You see them, the Klinex players...

ctx.x: He used to hold it with, uh, I can't think of the guy's name, but I know it. He's a bass player. That band he used to work with, the Charlie Shavers and Russell Crowe Colt.
You see them, the Klinex players, the Klinex players didn't hold a note to catch their breath.
